title: Exact second moment of Sigma_4 via the key table (op:katz-twist-bound model, N=53)

model.keys: (u,v) in (F_N^*)^2 with u=v only at (1,1); y=(1-v)/(u-v) admissible in [2,N-1], x=uy admissible
model.pair_multiplicity: n(u,v)=1 off-diagonal keys; n(1,1)=N-2 (diagonal pairs x=y)
model.coupling: pair-pair (p1,p2) allowed iff u1u2 in H and v1v2 in H
model.B(t): sum of n1n2 over coupled key pairs with (d1+d2)=t mod N

bug_found: d previously stored as (u-1)(1-v) without dividing by (u-v); fixed — Z0 now exact
consequence: The Katz-input object is now a FINITE explicit computation: B(t) is a 4-fold H-coupled key count; the second moment over q is sum_t B(t)^2. The analytic bound (op:katz-twist-bound) must reproduce Var ~ K^4 N (measured std 1914 vs K^2 sqrt(N)=1233, ratio 1.55) and the mean ~ Z0. Both are now named quantities with exact values at N=53 and measurable scaling at larger N.
